Original reproducer 'redteam-RT-12-run-mutations.sh <scratch clone of 8ab386b> <scratch>/mut deadlink'. Output: 'deadlink: preview-build exit 1'. 'deadlink: release-build exit 1', with 'links: 971 internal links on 32 pages of site/dist checked, 1 problems'. 'deadlink: report exit 1' with 'report: reports/open-items-report.json comes from a release build that did not finish ...'. At b9b8504 the report step exited 0. I reran the same reproducer on the clone with the fix reverted: removed 'holdForLinkCheck();' and 'settleLinkCheck(result.problems.length === 0);' from scripts/links.mjs, and the 'demoteOnFailedExit(process.env.OPEN_ITEMS_BUILD_ID);' call from the build-done hook in unverifiedRegistry.ts. That gave 'deadlink: report exit 0 -- report: open items report of ...: 8 open items used on 8 pages, 0 unknown items', which is the finding's behaviour. Regression test links-release-report.test.ts: 7 passed. With the same revert: 5 failed, 2 passed ('...1 open items used on 1 pages...: expected +0 to be 1'). Restored. Scenarios on the branch: (A) a clean 'OUT_DIR=<scratch> npm run build:release' exits 0, and npm run report exits 0 with '8 open items used on 8 pages, 0 unknown items' (JSON complete true, linkCheck passed). (B) A preview build after that leaves the report file byte-identical, and npm run report still exits 0 with the earlier release build's report (same generatedAt). A preview build with no report present writes none, and npm run report then exits 1 with 'no release build report found'. (D) In the dead-link copy, the release build exits 1 and the report is refused (complete false, linkCheck failed). The report stays refused after a preview build that still has the dead link (exit 1), after a preview build with the link removed (exit 0), and after 'RELEASE=1 node scripts/links.mjs' run by hand on that good build. A release build with the link removed exits 0 and the report is accepted. So a preview build never makes a failed release report pass. Six '// regression: P4-RT-12-04' comments are present.

A recorded behaviour change, logged in decisions/RT-FIX-P4-toolchain.md as a departure from P0-A4 instruction 5.8: the '(item, page)' lines on standard error now print only in the build-done hook, in the order of unverified.json. A release build that fails during the Astro step therefore prints none of them, where before it printed them as pages registered.

A small gap left in P4-RT-12-04. Suppose a postbuild is killed mid-check, so the report is left with linkCheck 'running', and a preview build then replaces site/dist. If someone then runs 'RELEASE=1 node scripts/links.mjs' by hand, the report is marked complete and npm run report accepts it, although the link check ran on the preview build. I simulated this: a preview build alone leaves the report refused, and only the manual RELEASE=1 postbuild makes it pass. It needs both a crash and that manual step.

Files changed outside the cluster's area, each with a reason recorded in the decisions fragment: site/astro.config.mjs now only re-exports the three functions; site/src/lib/siteAndBase.mjs and site/src/lib/openItemsReport.mjs are new. The report JSON gains the optional fields fallbackPages and linkCheck, which are not in CONTRACTS. Untouched: golden data, conventions, SPEC, CONTRACTS, package.json and the lockfile. The added lines contain no em-dash or en-dash and no .only or .skip.
